meta.name: before-you-build
meta.description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你：是创始人或产品经理，想在投入开发前确认想法是否靠谱。
copy.tagline_en: Check product risks before you build
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder or PM validating a product idea before development.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户提出要构建新东西时，Claude 会先做一次构建前风险审查，输出：风险高低与理由、最可能失败的单一假设、应先找的最小证据、下一步要做的事、暂缓不做的部分。
howto.when: 当用户表示要构建落地页、MVP、SaaS 等新产品，或准备添加采用效果不明确的重大功能，或准备公开发布时触发；修 bug、重构等已有明确验收标准的改动则不会触发。

say.text: 我要搭一个落地页，先帮我做before-you-build风险检查。
say.note: 会先给出风险判定，而不是直接开工。

say.text: 我想做个SaaS MVP，最该先验证哪个假设？
say.note: 会指出那个最可能让项目失败的假设。

say.text: 准备给应用加个新功能，先评估一下采用风险。
say.note: 会评估该功能风险，并给出下一步验证动作。

howto.what_en: After installing, when the user asks to build something, Claude first performs a pre-build risk review, producing: risk verdict, main assumption, smallest evidence to seek, next action, and what to delay.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user plans to build an MVP, SaaS, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature with unclear adoption/distribution impact; skip for fixes, refactors, dependency updates, or validated changes.

say_en.text: I'm building a landing page. Run before-you-build first.
say_en.note: Gives a risk verdict before building.

say_en.text: I'm building an MVP. What assumption should I check first?
say_en.note: Points to the single riskiest assumption.

say_en.text: I'm adding a major feature. Assess adoption risk first.
